about_the_game:
In the gritty underworld of Trapper: Drug Dealing RPG, players are thrust into the heart of a sprawling metropolis teeming with danger, opportunity, and the allure of power. Set in Cloverland where the line between law and corruption blurs, Trapper is a point and click RPG that is composed of mini-games that effect the out-come of your decisions and challenges players to navigate a morally ambiguous landscape where every decision has consequences.

You step into the shoes of Dre; an 18-year-old fledgling entrepreneur looking to make a name for themself in the cutthroat world of drugs, money, fast cars and turbo thots! As you rise through the ranks, you'll encounter rival gangs, corrupt officials, and desperate addicts, all vying for control of the city's lucrative drug trade.

But Trapper isn't just about making money and expanding your empire. It's about survival, loyalty, and the choices you make along the way. Will you build an empire based on fear and intimidation, or will you forge alliances and create a legacy of trust and respect?

With its immersive open-world environment, deep character customization, and morally complex narrative, Trapper offers players the chance to experience the thrills and dangers of the criminal underworld like never before. Are you ready to carve out your own destiny and become the ultimate Trapper?
